photo_orientation.control_coordinates: Architecture regions: normalized upright x,y; calibrated metric points in calibration-independent.json; original upright pixel per-pane controls in photo-glass-controls.json.

controls_are_provisional: Manual photo regions to guide comparison, not four-point UV mapping or measured elevations. Floor heights and projection depths are estimates pending visual camera comparison.
side_geometry_policy: 2011 image confirms a near continuous balcony group of four visible vertical stacks and a further group of at least three; assignments to edge1 indices3,4,5,8,9,10,11 are proportion estimates across uncertain footprint-step boundaries, not measured coordinates. Twelve long-side axes remain provisional. Near-front edge3 has one observed shallow arched attic/gable motif; the southeast chamfer has a blind cross-relief attic.

gable_m.width_note: Independent base corner controls; moulding projections, depth and mirrored centering remain estimates.

refinement_basis.outer_bay_metrics: Widths inferred from actual2025 outer window4F corners under the front homography; depth .7 remains estimated; no precision claim across noncoplanar surfaces.

front_pilaster_capital.basis: Hand-read visible shape and height from 2025 planar rectification; not measured, approx +/-0.35m. These are front capitals only.

southeast_chamfer.second_floor: Rectangular light, verified in P2011; corrected previous generic arched opening.
southeast_chamfer.sixth_floor: Blind stepped-cross relief verified in P2011; projection thickness and exact panel dimensions estimated.

central_glazing.method: 112 separate true pane solids, 6 independently registered source quadrilaterals; original JPEG unchanged. 3F and4F4columns5rows,5F4columns4rows and heavy central bars are counted from original 2025 pixels.

basement_vents.placement: Two nominally mirrored groups below central lower windows. Each group has .46m/1.20m/.46m lights at offsets -1/0/+1m around the central axis.
basement_vents.evidence: P2025 source x~1100–1940,y4845–4937 visibly shows several narrow/wide dark openings; planting boxes obscure lower and left portions. Count/layout symmetry, width and depth estimates are explicitly inferred; individual source map coordinates are not survey measurements.
basement_vents.geometry: Actual plinth polygon subtracts recess rectangles through the middle vertical layer; independent dark backing and recessed grille.

signage.mode: Raised closed font meshes, original licensed OFL font subset; font shape not logo-traced. Diamond mark simplified from visible source silhouette.

glazing_rebate_revision.reason: Glass seated within existing frame rebate; previous pane plane was behind the whole deep grid, causing excessive direct-light occlusion. Same-construction procedural panes and photographic panes updated consistently; wall/frame/UV geometry unchanged.
